{
	"name": "pnpm",
	"description": "Fast, disk space efficient package manager",
	"version": "4.12.3",
	"author": "Zoltan Kochan <z@kochan.io> (https://www.kochan.io/)",
	"bin": {
		"pnpm": "bin/pnpm.js",
		"pnpx": "bin/pnpx.js"
	},
	"bugs": {
		"url": "https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues"
	},
	"main": "lib/bin/pnpm.js",
	"files": [
		"lib",
		"!*.map",
		"bin"
	],
	"dependencies": {
		"@pnpm/cli-utils": "0.3.13",
		"@pnpm/command": "1.0.0",
		"@pnpm/common-cli-options-help": "0.1.4",
		"@pnpm/config": "8.1.2",
		"@pnpm/core-loggers": "4.0.1",
		"@pnpm/default-reporter": "7.1.0",
		"@pnpm/file-reporter": "0.1.0",
		"@pnpm/filter-workspace-packages": "2.0.9",
		"@pnpm/find-workspace-dir": "1.0.0",
		"@pnpm/logger": "3.1.0",
		"@pnpm/parse-cli-args": "1.0.0",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-audit": "1.0.3",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-import": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-installation": "1.1.3",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-listing": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-outdated": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-publishing": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-rebuild": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-script-runners": "1.0.3",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-server": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/plugin-commands-store": "1.0.4",
		"@pnpm/run-npm": "2.0.0",
		"@pnpm/tabtab": "0.0.1",
		"@pnpm/types": "5.0.0",
		"@zkochan/libnpx": "11.0.3",
		"chalk": "3.0.0",
		"common-tags": "1.8.0",
		"graceful-fs": "4.2.1",
		"is-ci": "2.0.0",
		"loud-rejection": "2.2.0",
		"pkgs-graph": "5.1.4",
		"ramda": "0.27.0",
		"render-help": "1.0.0",
		"split-cmd": "1.0.1",
		"update-notifier": "4.1.0",
		"which": "2.0.2"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"@pnpm/assert-project": "2.0.0",
		"@pnpm/constants": "3.0.0",
		"@pnpm/find-workspace-packages": "2.1.14",
		"@pnpm/lockfile-types": "2.0.0",
		"@pnpm/modules-yaml": "6.0.1",
		"@pnpm/prepare": "0.0.0",
		"@pnpm/read-package-json": "3.0.2",
		"@pnpm/read-project-manifest": "1.0.3",
		"@pnpm/write-project-manifest": "1.0.1",
		"@types/byline": "4.2.31",
		"@types/common-tags": "1.8.0",
		"@types/cross-spawn": "6.0.1",
		"@types/graceful-fs": "4.1.3",
		"@types/is-ci": "2.0.0",
		"@types/is-windows": "^1.0.0",
		"@types/mkdirp": "1.0.0",
		"@types/mz": "^2.7.0",
		"@types/ncp": "2.0.3",
		"@types/ramda": "^0.27.0",
		"@types/retry": "0.12.0",
		"@types/semver": "^7.1.0",
		"@types/table": "^4.0.7",
		"@types/tape-promise": "4.0.0",
		"@types/update-notifier": "4.1.0",
		"@types/which": "1.3.2",
		"@zkochan/rimraf": "1.0.0",
		"anonymous-npm-registry-client": "0.1.2",
		"byline": "5.0.0",
		"cross-spawn": "7.0.1",
		"deep-require-cwd": "1.0.0",
		"delay": "4.3.0",
		"dir-is-case-sensitive": "1.0.2",
		"execa": "4.0.0",
		"exists-link": "2.0.0",
		"is-windows": "1.0.2",
		"load-json-file": "6.2.0",
		"make-dir": "3.0.2",
		"mz": "2.7.0",
		"ncp": "2.0.0",
		"normalize-newline": "3.0.0",
		"npm-run-all": "4.1.5",
		"p-any": "3.0.0",
		"path-exists": "4.0.0",
		"pnpm": "4.12.3",
		"read-yaml-file": "2.0.0",
		"retry": "0.12.0",
		"semver": "7.1.3",
		"symlink-dir": "3.1.2",
		"tape-promise": "4.0.0",
		"tree-kill": "1.2.2",
		"write-json-file": "4.0.0",
		"write-pkg": "4.0.0",
		"write-yaml-file": "4.0.0"
	},
	"directories": {
		"test": "test"
	},
	"homepage": "https://pnpm.js.org",
	"keywords": [
		"dependency manager",
		"install",
		"installer",
		"uninstall",
		"remove",
		"link",
		"prune",
		"shrinkwrap",
		"lockfile",
		"fast",
		"rapid",
		"efficient",
		"package.json",
		"packages",
		"dependencies",
		"symlinks",
		"hardlinks",
		"modules",
		"npm",
		"package manager",
		"monorepo",
		"multi-package",
		"workspace"
	],
	"license": "MIT",
	"preferGlobal": true,
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=10.13"
	},
	"repository": {
		"type": "git",
		"url": "git+https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.git"
	},
	"scripts": {
		"start": "npm run tsc -- --watch",
		"lint": "tslint -c ../../tslint.json src/**/*.ts test/**/*.ts",
		"registry-mock": "registry-mock",
		"test:tap": "cd ../.. && c8 --reporter lcov --reports-dir packages/pnpm/coverage ts-node packages/pnpm/test --type-check",
		"pretest:e2e": "rimraf node_modules/.bin/pnpm",
		"test:e2e": "registry-mock prepare && run-p -r registry-mock test:tap",
		"_test": "pnpm run compile && cross-env PNPM_REGISTRY_MOCK_PORT=7780 pnpm run test:e2e",
		"test": "pnpm run _test",
		"prepublishOnly": "pnpm run compile && npm cache clear --force && publish-packed --prune",
		"postpublish": "publish-packed",
		"compile": "rimraf lib tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc --build"
	},
	"publishconfig": {
		"tag": "next"
	}
}
